gloss: to develop an illness; to fall ill

definitions.gloss: to develop an illness; to fall ill
definitions.explanation: For symptoms of a disease to appear or manifest; to come down with an illness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感染|かんせん}して→感染する：26931_kansensuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{発病|はつびょう}する⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: It takes time from infection to developing symptoms.
My grandfather developed the illness when he was 60.

examples.japanese: ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{発病|はつびょう}する⟦ケース→ケース：03841_keesu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{少|すく}なくない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: Cases where the illness develops due to stress are not uncommon.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{発|はつ}→〜発：04026_hatsu⟧ (occurrence/onset) and {病|びょう} (illness). Focuses on the moment when a disease first manifests symptoms, rather than the ongoing state of being sick. Often used in medical contexts and news reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発病|はつびょう}する⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ — before developing the illness
- ⟦{発病|はつびょう}→発病：27015_hatsubyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧ — risk of developing the disease
- ⟦{発病|はつびょう}→発病：27015_hatsubyou⟧⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧ — age of onset
- ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{発病|はつびょう}する — to develop the illness suddenly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{発症|はっしょう}する→発症する：22367_hasshousuru⟧ — to develop symptoms (very close synonym; ⟦{発症|はっしょう}→発症：09016_hasshou⟧ is more common in modern medical writing)
- ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ — to get sick (everyday/general expression, less clinical)
- {罹患|りかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to be affected by a disease (formal/medical; emphasizes contracting rather than symptom onset)
